age.leftOut.noFirstFlight: {count, plural, other {# missing first flight date}}
age.leftOut.beforeFirstFlight: {count, plural, other {# invalid date (flight before first flight)}}
age.todayNote: Because retirement dates aren't tracked, "Age today" reflects total elapsed time since first flight, not active service.
track.error.notFr24Csv: This CSV is not a Flightradar24 track: it needs Timestamp and Position columns.
track.error.unknownFile: Give a Flightradar24 CSV or KML file, or a KML or GPX file whose points have times.
track.error.noTimes: The file has no track with times: it needs at least two points, each with its time.
track.problem.outsideTimes: The track runs from {day} {from} to {to} UTC, outside this flight (takeoff {takeoff} UTC).
track.problem.otherDay: The track is from {trackDay}, but this flight is on {day}.
track.problem.length: The track is {km, number} km long, but {from} to {to} is {gc, number} km.
track.problem.direction: The track does not run from {from} to {to}: it starts {startKm} km from {from} and ends {endKm} km from {to}.
track.problem.tooLittle: The track covers too little of the flight to draw ({km} of {gc} km), so the great circle stays.
track.problem.noPositions: The aircraft has no positions that day.
track.problem.noLeg: No leg in the aircraft's traces fits this flight.
